node.title: Re: amazon sns subscription (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [bigup401],

I don't know anything about SNS; but looking at the source of [mod://Amazon::SNS], there appears to be an undocumented method Subscribe with the arguments $protocol, $topicarn, $endpoint - is this what you're looking for? The only reference to deleting something is the DeleteTopic method.

A quick search on CPAN shows the module [mod://Paws::SNS], does that perhaps help more? Update: That module also appears to be [https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/developer/category/perl/|advertised by Amazon themselves].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
